notes.title: Small update fixing some things
notes.content:
In this small update to Super Yapori Minigames, there have been some bug fixes and issues, as well as some minor additions.

- Character movement has been adjusted

- Three new skins have been added.

- Music mode has undergone some changes.

- The platform mode tutorial has been fixed.

If you find any bugs or issues, please let me know. I'm keeping an eye on them.
